值得閱讀的理由

  • 整理索尼計畫於2028年前後逐步淘汰實體遊戲光碟所引發的玩家與開發者反彈。
  • 說明數位遊戲的授權模式如何牽涉遊戲所有權、保存與轉售等玩家關注的議題。
  • 從二手PS5 Pro高於新品的售價，呈現遊戲主機市場供需失衡與玩家的購買困境。

摘要

實體遊戲退場引發反彈

作者以「二手主機竟比新品更貴」的荒謬現象開場，接著談到索尼計畫逐步淘汰實體光碟的爭議。許多玩家以「沒有光碟就不買」表達不滿；他們在意的不只是無法收藏或轉售，也擔心數位化讓選擇權與定價權集中到平台手中，而玩家未必能因此省下費用。

數位遊戲的所有權疑慮

玩家擔憂，數位遊戲若因服務終止或授權問題下架，已付費購買的內容也可能從遊戲庫中消失。作者提到，索尼在相關訴訟中主張，PlayStation Store上的數位產品是授權給玩家，而非出售給玩家；這番說法進一步加深了玩家對遊戲所有權的疑慮。

前PlayStation執行長肖恩・萊登也公開表示，對逐步取消實體光碟感到失望。他認為，即使實體遊戲玩家只占約兩成，這群人仍可能是最忠實的支持者，甚至有人會購買多份遊戲。萊登並指出，若玩家不能轉售遊戲，就很難說自己真正擁有它；全面轉向數位形式，可能損害PlayStation的品牌形象。

索尼是否會重新考慮政策

作者轉述，YouTube頻道「Moore’s Law Is Dead」主持人湯姆在節目中稱，有消息指出索尼曾向大量遊戲開發者發出問卷，詢問取消實體光碟是否會造成影響。此消息尚未獲得證實，但引起玩家議論：索尼是在聽取意見，還是事後才補做調查？作者也指出，部分熱門作品的實體版本仍占一定銷售比例，顯示實體市場並未完全消失。

PlayStation另向玩家進行品牌調查，雖未直接詢問取消光碟的決定，仍提供開放留言欄，讓玩家表達不滿並強調實體遊戲對保存與選擇的重要性。日本一軟體的社長也透露，公司正與索尼討論2028年的計畫，並認為索尼似乎正在聽取客戶意見，因此最終方案仍有變動可能。不過，社群也有人懷疑索尼尋求開發者回饋，可能是為既定決策尋找背書。

二手PS5 Pro價格高於新品

在光碟政策尚未明朗之際，GameStop標出的二手PS5 Pro價格又讓玩家錯愕：光碟版約1,499美元，數位版約1,399美元，比新品高出約500至600美元。流出的內部備忘錄甚至稱，高於新品定價是刻意安排，令玩家難以接受。媒體推測，供貨有限、GTA 6上市前的需求，以及特定韌體版本因越獄傳聞而受到追捧，都可能推升二手價格。

作者感嘆，玩家如今不只擔心買不起新主機，甚至可能連二手機也負擔不起。他表示，若有足夠預算，或許會選擇能玩到更多平價遊戲的電腦，而不是一台缺乏光碟、又無法讓玩家真正擁有遊戲的主機。片尾提到，名為Kyty PS5的免費模擬器近期取得技術突破，已能啟動部分2D與3D遊戲；不過影片字幕在介紹其進展時中斷，未提供後續內容。

作者指出，過去的換裝遊戲多半僅停留在挑選服飾與外觀搭配，但黑馬獨立遊戲《DressMaker》打破了這項常規，讓玩家親自體驗將布料轉化為華麗禮服的完整工藝。該作在 Steam 平台迅速斬獲 98% 的壓倒性好評，同上人數甚至突破 4 萬人並超越諸多 3A 級遊戲。其兼具自由度與極致細節的慢活模擬，不僅吸引女性玩家，也讓無數男性玩家沉迷於色彩搭配與裁縫世界之中。

will share with you the hit story of. DressMaker, the game that lets you. become a tailor. If there’s anything. I’ve missed or anything you’d like. to add, feel free to leave a comment. below. DressMaker’s player count. occasionally even surpassing them. So,. what kind of magic does this seemingly. ordinary tailoring game have that. allows so many players to dive. headfirst into it? experience can easily pick it up. start to finish, as many players soon. discover that while designing clothes. is joyful, actually starting the. construction is a different story. When. designing clothes, I feel like Coco. Chanel, a fashionista leading the. trends, but when it comes time to sew,. I feel like a laborer in an unknown. London garment factory during the. Even more extreme: what if the game. doesn't have a fur option? Then a true. artist insists on hand-crafting it; one. player took individual feathers and. pieced them together, eventually. forcing the creation of a stunningly. gorgeous fox dress. This near-maniacal. dedication to craftsmanship left many. players humbled, because while you’re. still trying to figure out how to make. a dress look decent, others are already. challenging themselves with high art in. the game. As. a result, the community is full of. self-deprecating jokes from players,. like, "Before I saw your work, I. realized I was basically just playing. around." Everyone is making high art in. this game, reaching levels I could. never attain in my lifetime, so forget. it—I'm just going to make a potato. sack dress. "We are definitely not. playing the same game, lol!" It's. hilarious to think that this dress. might have cost two quadrillion dollars. to make, yet the game only gives you. 100 bucks as a reward. as sewing machine pedals, leaving the. community completely stunned. The. creative gowns made by players have. shown others the game's potential and. the players' own imagination. However,. with the game's sudden popularity and. success, the reason for its creation. surfaced, and players realized there. was a heartwarming story behind the. studio. Dressmaker was actually created. by Clive, a small team under Free Lives. . The core development team consists of. only three people: programmer and. designer R, artist Sera, and producer. Jonathan. The inspiration for this game. didn't come from market research, nor. was it a random decision to make a. dress-up game; it originated from the. lives of Jonathan and his girlfriend,. Sabrina—not that Sabrina the Teenage. Witch, though. I'm terrified. >> Sabrina is an experienced fashion. designer with real sewing skills and a. deep interest in fashion history. She. learned to sew from her mother as a. child and even wore a dress she made. herself on her first date with Jonathan. . She originally intended to pursue a. career in fashion design, but was later. diagnosed with Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (. EDS), a rare condition affecting. connective tissue that severely. impacted her ability to continue sewing. . For someone who loved sewing from a. young age and dreamed of a career in. fashion design, this was undoubtedly a. formidable obstacle. The two created a simple. prototype, and later Jonathan brought. the concept to Free Lives, where the. team built a playable itch.io version. in just three weeks. When it first. launched, the studio couldn't get.

publisher Free Lives to support. development due to low download numbers. , but with player demand and downloads. surging, Free Lives finally officially. approved the development of the full. game. Dressmaker later achieved great. results with TikTok promotion; many. female players were excited to see they. could design their own clothes, and. Sabrina participated in all game design. decisions. As a consultant and quality. assessor, she gradually incorporated. the years of experience she had. accumulated into the game. As an indie. title, Dressmaker's success proves once. again that games don't need to. deliberately cater to a specific group,. or even everyone. What truly convinces. players to willingly spend their money. has never been flashy marketing or a. massive development budget, but rather. engaging content and the passion that. players can feel from the work.
